title: ActionAtlas: A VideoQA Benchmark for Domain-specialized Action Recognition

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy across varying video frame sampling rates (e.g., 1, 4, 8, 16, 32 frames) to test whether models rely on single-frame spatial cues (static bias) rather than actually modeling the temporal dynamics of complex actions.

Testing the benchmark's questions by passing them through a text-only language model (GPT-4-Text) without video inputs to identify and filter out questions that can be answered using only textual priors or phrasing shortcuts.
